trials.summary: Trial 01 (lr_mu=0.1551, mu_anneal=0.4535, lr_gamma=0.7990, gamma_anneal=0.2968): objective 0.1127 +/- 0.0825, 0 diverged cells; gamma within ~1% at T100 but under-recovered at low T (-45/-29% at T05), while mu overshoots at mid transmission (+137-157%) and undershoots at high T (-23 to -38%)
trials.key_insight: The residual is a mu-location problem (large low/mid-T overshoot plus high-T undershoot, the latter weighted most), not a gamma-divergence one: gamma is accurate at high T and degrades only in the known low-count regime, with no diverged cell

protocol.model: series-21 (17g) model on REAL data; mu reward = Anuar's per-run likelihood (MU_REWARD=loglik_mean), mu score denominator = per-experiment sigma_prop (MU_SCORE=sigma_prop)
protocol.no_clipping: CLIP = inf AND parameter clamps removed (mu/gamma unbounded)

divergence_guard.note: STOP the experiment and record diverged/diverged_at if a parameter leaves this band (guards the photon-count blow-up)

protocol.objective: T-weighted mean of CAP-capped per-cell rel-sq errors; err_i = min(rel_sq_i, CAP=1.0); w(T) = 0.25 + 0.75*T/100; objective = sum(w*err)/sum(w)
